tool_derived.note: TOOL-DERIVED and machine-checked. Every field here is reproduced from the pinned checkout by `python3 tools/hns-map-data/hns_route.py inventory`, and `hns_route.py inventory --check tools/hns-runtime-probe/evidence/hns-cross-region-inventory.json` fails when this block drifts from that source. The analyzer verifies the checkout revision and the cleanliness of everything it reads before producing any of it.
what_it_can_prove: a warp whose trigger metatile carries a behaviour the engine's warp predicates accept (src/field_control_avatar.c IsWarpMetatileBehavior / TryArrowWarp) is FUNCTIONAL
a `connections` entry with an empty `dest = src - offset` window, or an impassable border column, is DEAD (src/fieldmap.c)
every `warp`/`warpsilent`/`warpteleport` script command whose target is an H&S map in another region, with the exact file and line that contains it
what_it_cannot_prove: whether a warp whose trigger metatile is ordinary floor actually fires: 1719 of this build's 3608 warp tiles sit on non-warp metatiles that the engine still accepts as step-on warps, so map data alone does not settle it. Those edges are reported as `unproven` with the observed metatile behaviour rather than asserted either way

whether a script command is reachable: deciding that needs the script call graph, which weighs 28902 labels in this revision. Script commands are therefore reported as CANDIDATES with their file and line, and `shared_include` marks the ones living in a file that holds more than one map's script set

manual_engine_source_verified.note: MANUALLY ENGINE-SOURCE-VERIFIED. This half is NOT produced by hns_route.py and is not claimed to be. It decides the edges the analyzer reports as undecided from map data, and it records the script-command transitions an analyzer without a call graph cannot resolve. Every verdict carries the exact source that supports it. It is machine-checked in two ways: `hns_route.py inventory --check` fails if any undecided edge has no verdict here or if a verdict contradicts the tool-derived half, and `HnsLocationRuntimeEvidenceTest` asserts the same partition from the Kotlin suite.

evidence: data/maps/ReceptionGate_hns/events.inc:18 -- `warp_def 20, 9, 0, 0, MAP_ROUTE22_HNS` names Route 22 and depth 0, so it is a warp event and not a placeholder

data/maps/ReceptionGate_hns/scripts.inc:34-49 -- `ReceptionGate_Trigger` is the coord event at (11,14); it checks VAR_ECRUTEAK_CITY_THEATER >= 8 and FLAG_BADGE08_GET and pushes the player back with Common_Movement_WalkDown1 on either failure
data/maps/ReceptionGate_hns/events.inc:21 -- the trigger is a coord_event at (11,14), which is the only tile connecting the arrival corridor to (20,9)

hns_route.py records the trigger tile's metatile as MB_NORMAL. 1719 of the build's 3608 warp tiles sit on MB_NORMAL floor, so this is the normal shape for a step-on warp and does not make the edge dead

data/maps/CinnabarIsland_hns/events.inc:22 -- canonical warp_def for the Kanto -> Johto whiteout/teleport destination; its coordinate is the one this hardcoded accessor returns, so the warp event and the destination agree
the trigger tile (41,1) carries MB_OCEAN_WATER with collision 0, so the player can be standing on it while surfing, and the arrival tile (20,12) in New Bark Town has collision 0 with elevation 3
hns_route.py reports it as undecided because the trigger metatile is not a metatile warp behaviour; that is a limit of the analyzer, not evidence against the warp
behaviour confirmed independently by decoding data/tilesets/primary/general/metatile_attributes.bin through include/global.fieldmap.h's METATILE_ATTR_BEHAVIOR_MASK
data/maps/FuchsiaCity_hns/events.inc:33 -- canonical warp_def for the Kanto -> Johto whiteout/teleport destination, the same shape as Cinnabar

the trigger tile (19,30) carries MB_NORMAL with collision 1, so the engine fires it as a door warp from the tile in front (src/field_control_avatar.c:1134-1159 TryDoorWarp tests the metatile AHEAD of the player). hns_route.py cannot see that because the approach is not part of the warp_def
arrival tile (20,12) in New Bark Town has collision 0
data/maps/MtSilver_1F_WaterfallRoom_hns/events.inc:36 -- warp_def at (43,7) to SnowsweptCavern_hns

the trigger tile (43,7) carries MB_NORMAL and is the ONLY walkable tile in its 3x3 neighbourhood: (42,6),(44,6),(42,7),(44,7) are MB_EAST_ARROW_WARP with collision 1 and (43,6) is impassable, so the warp_def tile is the warp, reached from (43,8) or (44,8) which are walkable MB_NORMAL
the landing tile SnowsweptCavern_hns (50,68) is walkable, and its own reverse warp (50,68) -> Mt Silver is the same shape

reachability_from_an_early_legal_save.start: the issue #1 progression chain's furthest accepted checkpoint (Azalea Town area, two Johto badges, three party members)
reachability_from_an_early_legal_save.method: flood fill over all 560 H&S maps using the engine's warp and connection predicates (surf/waterfall HM gates read from src/field_move.c IsFieldMoveUnlocked_Surf / _Waterfall), at three assumption levels
evidence: no Surf and no Waterfall: 161 maps reached, ZERO cross-region edges
Surf without Waterfall: 169 maps reached, ZERO cross-region edges
Surf and Waterfall: 342 maps reached, which is where the first cross-region edges appear
Surf is mandatory and needs FLAG_BADGE04_GET: both the New Bark Town east edge (x=29, rows 11-14) and the Route 27 west edge (x=0, rows 22-25) are MB_OCEAN_WATER

Waterfall is mandatory and needs FLAG_BADGE08_GET: Tohjo Falls Cavern's west component joins its centre and east rooms only through the MB_WATERFALL column x=29-34, rows 12-17, and Route 27's east half is reachable no other way
even with Surf and Waterfall, ReceptionGate's (11,14) trigger requires VAR_ECRUTEAK_CITY_THEATER >= 8, set only by TinTower_RoofDay_hns (Ho-Oh) or WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_hns (Lugia)

Fly is not a shortcut: of every sMapHealLocations entry exactly one is cross-region (MAPSEC_ROCKET_HIDEOUT_HNS -> Pallet Town with HEAL_LOCATION_NONE, hence unusable), and every CANFLY city is gated by its own FLAG_VISITED_*, set only by physically entering
neither the tool-derived inventory nor the manual script audit finds any Alola <-> Johto transition
Alola links only to Kanto: MelemeleIsle_hns -> Route13_hns with no gate, and the reverse gated by checkitem ITEM_STRANGE_SOUVENIR, an item sold in the Kanto shop MtMoon_Shop_hns
